definitions.explanation: Running a test, measurement, or examination a second time, usually to confirm an abnormal result, monitor a change, or double-check a decision. Most often heard in medical contexts — for example, after a health check-up returns borderline numbers — but also used for inspections and technical tests in general.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}、{再検査|さいけんさ}を{受|う}ける。
examples.english: I will have a follow-up test next month.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}の{結果|けっか}、{再検査|さいけんさ}が{必要|ひつよう}だと{言|い}われた。
examples.english: Based on the health check-up results, I was told I needed a follow-up test.

examples.japanese: {血液|けつえき}の{数値|すうち}に{異常|いじょう}があったので、{医者|いしゃ}は{再検査|さいけんさ}を{指示|しじ}した。
examples.english: Because there was an abnormality in the blood values, the doctor ordered a follow-up test.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}の{製品|せいひん}に{欠陥|けっかん}が{見|み}つかったため、{全|すべ}てのロットで{再検査|さいけんさ}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Because a defect was found in the factory's products, a reexamination was carried out on all the lots.

notes:
Composed of the prefix {再|さい} (again, re-) + {検査|けんさ} (inspection, examination, test). Appears most frequently in the medical phrase {再検査|さいけんさ}を{受|う}ける (to undergo a follow-up test), since Japanese annual health check-ups routinely flag borderline values and ask the patient to come back for confirmation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再検査|さいけんさ}を{受|う}ける: to undergo a follow-up test
- {再検査|さいけんさ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ: a follow-up test is needed
- {再検査|さいけんさ}を{受|う}けるよう{指示|しじ}する: to instruct (someone) to undergo a follow-up test
- {再検査|さいけんさ}{通知|つうち}: notice of the need for a follow-up test
- {血液|けつえき}の{再検査|さいけんさ}: a follow-up blood test

VERBAL USE:
The word can take する to act as a verb: {再検査|さいけんさ}する — to reexamine, to retest. In that form, the subject is the one doing the checking: {医者|いしゃ}が{数値|すうち}を{再検査|さいけんさ}した (the doctor retested the values). In patient-side usage the passive-like {再検査|さいけんさ}を{受|う}ける is much more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精密|せいみつ}{検査|けんさ}: detailed examination / thorough test — a more in-depth follow-up, usually ordered when the initial screening shows a clear problem.
- {追加|ついか}{検査|けんさ}: additional test — tests added on top of what was originally planned, not necessarily a redo.
- {再診|さいしん}: a return visit to the doctor — refers to the appointment itself, not to the test.

USAGE:
Beyond medicine, you will encounter the word in quality control (factory inspections, food safety), academic contexts (retaking a test), and engineering (retesting equipment). In all these uses, it keeps the core sense of "checking again."
